recipe.title: Strawberry Cheesecake Protein Crunch Bowl
recipe.summary: Creamy strawberry-cheesecake protein yogurt topped with fresh strawberries and crunchy graham cracker.
recipe.story: One scoop of strawberry cheesecake protein turns plain Greek yogurt into a five-minute dessert-style bowl without pudding mix or cottage cheese.
ingredients: 1 cup Chobani Nonfat Plain Greek Yogurt
1 scoop Clean Simple Eats Strawberry Cheesecake Protein Powder
1 full Honey Maid Graham Cracker sheet, crushed
instructions: Stir or blend the Greek yogurt, protein powder, and water until completely smooth.
Spoon the cheesecake mixture into a bowl.
Crush the graham cracker over the bowl immediately before serving.
tips: For meal prep, store the graham cracker separately and add it immediately before serving.
Nutrition varies by yogurt, protein powder, and graham cracker brand.
